shell_commands_self_reported.command: find ./docs -type f -not -path '*/.*' 2>/dev/null | sort; echo "---"; find ./docs -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l; ls -la ./reports 2>/dev/null || echo "no reports dir"

for f in $(find ./docs -type f | sort); do printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$f" "$(file -b --mime-type "$f")" "$(wc -c < "$f" | tr -d ' ')" "$(wc -l < "$f" | tr -d ' ')"; done; echo "--- CSV heads"; for f in docs/csv/*.csv; do echo "## $f"; head -3 "$f"; echo "rows(incl header, no trailing-newline fix): $

for f in docs/html/*.html; do echo "## $f"; grep -io '<title[^>]*>[^<]*</title>' "$f" | head -1; grep -io '<h1[^>]*>[^<]*' "$f" | head -1; done; for f in docs/text/*.txt; do echo "## $f"; head -3 "$f"; done
wc -c docs/csv/*.csv docs/html/*.html docs/text/*.txt && wc -l docs/csv/*.csv docs/html/*.html docs/text/*.txt && file -b docs/csv/*.csv docs/html/*.html docs/text/*.txt

head -3 docs/csv/inventory.csv docs/csv/quarterly-sales.csv docs/csv/staff-roster.csv && python3 -I -c "
import csv,sys
for p in sys.argv[1:]:
    r=list(csv.reader(open(p,newline='')))
    print(p, 'records=',len(r), 'cols=',sorted(set(len(x) for x in r)))
" docs/csv/inventory.csv docs/csv/quarterl
grep -ioH -m1 -e '<title' -e '<h1' docs/html/*.html; for f in docs/text/*.txt; do echo "## $f"; head -3 "$f"; done

wc -c docs/csv/inventory.csv docs/csv/quarterly-sales.csv docs/csv/staff-roster.csv docs/html/onboarding-guide.html docs/html/pricing-table.html docs/html/release-faq.html docs/html/status-page.html docs/text/changelog.txt docs/text/meeting-notes.txt docs/text/style-guide.txt && wc -l docs/csv/inven
head -3 docs/csv/inventory.csv && head -3 docs/csv/quarterly-sales.csv && head -3 docs/csv/staff-roster.csv

grep -i -m1 -e '<title' -e '<h1' docs/html/onboarding-guide.html docs/html/pricing-table.html docs/html/release-faq.html docs/html/status-page.html && head -3 docs/text/changelog.txt && head -3 docs/text/meeting-notes.txt && head -3 docs/text/style-guide.txt

python3 -I -c "import csv,sys
for p in sys.argv[1:]:
    r=list(csv.reader(open(p,newline='')))
    print(p, len(r), sorted(set(len(x) for x in r)))" docs/csv/inventory.csv docs/csv/quarterly-sales.csv docs/csv/staff-roster.csv

grep -o -i -e '<h[1-6][^>]*>[^<]*' docs/html/*.html | head -20; file docs/csv/inventory.csv docs/csv/quarterly-sales.csv docs/csv/staff-roster.csv docs/html/onboarding-guide.html docs/html/pricing-table.html docs/html/release-faq.html docs/html/status-page.html docs/text/changelog.txt docs/text/meet

cat docs/csv/inventory.csv docs/csv/quarterly-sales.csv docs/csv/staff-roster.csv && echo "--- trailing newline check:" && tail -c1 docs/csv/inventory.csv | od -An -c && tail -c1 docs/csv/quarterly-sales.csv | od -An -c && tail -c1 docs/csv/staff-roster.csv | od -An -c
